# L'ICÔNE Beauty & Aesthetics

> Beauty salon in Kfarchima (also spelled Kfarshima), Baabda District, Lebanon. Nails (gel color, rubber base, dip powder, gel and acrylic extensions, manicures and pedicures), waxing, eyebrows, makeup and lashes. Book on WhatsApp +961 76 048 557.

## About
- Opened 20 September 2026
- Location: Kfarchima, Baabda District, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon (near Hadath and Choueifat)
- Booking: by appointment on WhatsApp +961 76 048 557
- Prices in US dollars
- Website: https://www.iconelb.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/icone.lb/

## Prices
### Manicure & pedicure
- Pose vernis: $5–6 (Regular polish, no manicure)
- Manicure: $7
- Dry pedicure: $10
- Spa pedicure: $15
- False nails: $12

### Gel, rubber base & dip powder
- Pose gel color: $10 (Gel color only)
- Manicure + gel color: $15
- Pedicure + gel color: $20
- Rubber base: $15
- Rubber base + gel color: $25 (Add a manicure for $5)
- Dip powder set: $15
- Dip powder with rubber base: $30

### Extensions
- Full set gel: $50
- Refill gel: $30
- Full set acrylic: $60
- Refill acrylic: $40

### French, chrome & nail art
- Gel color French: $15
- Rubber base + French: $20 (Add a manicure for $5)
- Chrome: +$5 (Added to any set)
- Design: +$1–3 (Hand-painted art, added to any set)

### Brows & face
- Eyebrows: $5
- Moustache: $2 (Upper lip)
- Facial hair trimmer: $10

### Waxing
- Full legs: $15
- Half legs: $10
- Full arms: $10
- Half arms: $7
- Underarms: $5

### Makeup & lashes
- Full makeup: $50
- Fake lashes: $10
- Cluster lashes: $15
